subject: Air freight quote to DFW
body:
Hello,

Could you please quote the fastest air freight option to DFW (Dallas, US)? Please include pickup from our warehouse and arrange the truck to the departure airport.

The shipment consists of 9 pieces of precision instruments, with a gross weight of 1795 kg and a total volume of 12.58 cbm. The goods will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-29.

Please send us your all-in price in EUR and confirm the earliest arrival at DFW.

Viele Gruesse / Many greetings
Deniz Yilmaz
Rheintal Elektronik GmbH
